status: Read-only source-credit attribution; no production, build or runtime actions
metric: Conservative source-weighted retired-policy indicator, not functionality percentage or delivery acceptance
path_scope_validation: Every credited original logical path is included by the separate denominator inventory.
deduplication: Original logical path plus normalized owned method signature; frozen helper closures deliberately omitted.
attribution_limits: This is a conservative syntactic/source-attribution indicator: whole semantic delivery cannot be derived from it, and it is not a formally proved lower bound on functionality.

Eligible owned original methods were manually selected by component scope, then a deterministic line rule excludes unchanged C++ lines, native/ownership/diagnostic expressions and uncertain mixed lines.

Pure declaration, constructor/destructor, header/static-data and unresolved attribution receive zero credit. HostMapping is integrated but receives zero credit here until its frozen original ownership mapping is resolved.
The full6915-line owned original-body envelope is context only, not eligible credit and not an upper bound for all migrated code.
Snapshot source identity/routing is not proof of current functional, performance, platform or browser acceptance.
External providers outside net remain registered unfinished goal work. No first-party metric silently completes or excludes them.
historical_acceptance_ledger: docs/rust/net-migration-status.json accepted_rewrite_slices; not automatically current acceptance
